# Cumulative icount drift since the anchor

*Generated by `script/metrics` from git history (helpers/baseline_drift.py), read at `daee08421`. Do not edit it by hand. An appendix to [notes/project-metrics.md](../project-metrics.md), for milestone 415 item 3. calef ruled on 2026-09-26 that this is a report and not a gate (§190).*

Every figure is per iteration, against a fixed anchor rather than the last floor. The anchors are the 2026-09-15 audit's: aarch64 `744314290` (2026-07-31), riscv64 `8c279536f` (2026-08-04), x86_64 `d31aa77c9` (2026-08-26). `floor` is the committed number. `restamp` is the compiler term `--restamp` has carried since the last `--save`, and `combined` is both. The tripwire is 10% per save.

`on main` is the merge queue's reading in 2026W44, `main` at `daee08421` against the anchor, and `unexplained` is the part of it no line in [bench/attributions.tsv](../../bench/attributions.tsv) accounts for (calef, 2026-10-22, #2554). The weekly chart plots the largest `unexplained` per architecture; past 5% is a lane. `accounted for` says which rows of each save's step a line explains.
